deficits.suggestion: Install a raised crossing platform at this signalised intersection to provide a refuge for pedestrians crossing a wide road.

deficits.evidence: no kerb ramps visible at the crossing
deficits.suggestion: Install dropped kerbs at both sides of the signalised crossing to improve accessibility for wheelchair users and pedestrians with mobility aids.

deficits.evidence: some street lighting visible but not ample
deficits.suggestion: Install additional street lighting along the right side of the road to improve visibility for pedestrians and drivers, especially during low-light conditions.

ratings.reason: The right side of the crossing is obscured by a utility pole and the vehicle's position, making it impossible to confirm the absence of a refuge.
The kerb edge on the right is partially visible but the resolution and angle are insufficient to determine if ramps are present.
The frames are taken in bright daylight, making it impossible to assess the adequacy of street lighting.
